regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your kind recently received. I am enrolling your Sister and her Husband in the Seraphic Mass Association - emergency and special - and I hope you may be able to send us a favorable report. Thanks be to God, we have notable reports as through this source of blessing every day. I am sure that if they turn to God as best they can and pray to Him with confidence as we all ought to try to do, He in His mercy will enable them to give the doctors and all concerning a good surprise. Something they could do specially to please the good God in case Mr. Sherman is cured, in thanks-giving; would be to: "like-promise" to be earnest in finding out for themselves, some-(thing) about the difference of the relationship of the methodest denomination with the Mother-Church; or that they will look into and find out some of the reasons why Catholecs try so much to imitate Jesus in his love and reverence for Mary, His own dearest Virgin Mother. "Behold thy son." Jesus said to His sorrowing Mother and the foot of the Cross, referring to the youthful Apostle John - and in him as theologians and the fathers of the holy Church have always taught, - in St. John - refering to all followers of His doctrine. Then as in the same breath to St. John: "Behold thy Mother." If religion is the greatest science of all ages - "The science of our happy dependence on God and our neighboy.", which definition no one seems to question, then there can be but one religion. In like manner if: "We are Christians only in asmuch as we believe in Jesus Christ and keep His words - His doctrine - so there can be but one Christianity. Therefore, its up to each one of us individually to examine into our own conscience whether we be Christians in reality or only in name. Too, it ought to be our happy privilege to prefect ourselves in that faith more and more, and to findout its infallible Guide on earth.
